title: Dashboard Layout and Controls
summary: Feedback on the G70 dashboard layout is split between praise for the look and usability, criticism of the styling and distracting controls, and several fragments that mention layout or menus without enough context for clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive feedback praises the dashboard’s overall look and layout.

negative.summary: Negative feedback criticizes the dashboard layout as visually childish and the crystal-style controls as distracting.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention efficient dashboard operation, dashboard layout, or menu arrangement changes without enough context to classify sentiment consistently.

limitations: This topic has very few examples, so the observed themes are limited.
Most sampled fragments are undetermined, which restricts clear interpretation of customer sentiment.
Some undetermined fragments are too brief or ambiguous to classify confidently.
